tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return clean, readable Markdown (main-content extraction, no nav/ads) with title, byline, language and word count. First calls each day are free, then $0.003 per call in USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Structured metadata for a public URL: title, canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter card, JSON-LD, headings, RSS/Atom feeds, internal and external links. First calls each day are free, then $0.002 per call in USDC on Base via x402.
